What we do

Pest control services

One call covers the pests that bother Coachella Valley homes — treated with integrated pest management and eco-friendly products on request.

Ant Control

Ants in the kitchen, the walls or the yard — found at the source and treated so they stop coming back.

Cockroach Control

Roaches cleared from kitchens and bathrooms, with follow-up to make sure the problem is really gone.

Bed Bug Treatment

Thorough bed bug treatment for bedrooms and living areas, so you can sleep easy again.

Rodent Control & Exclusion

Rodent control and exclusion — sealing the ways in, not just catching what is already inside.

Wasp & Scorpion Removal

Wasps, scorpions and other stinging pests removed safely from your home and yard.

Spiders, Crickets & Beetles

Spiders, crickets, earwigs and beetles — plus feces cleanup and sanitation when a job needs it.
